parts.gloss: he who is not subjected to

words.gloss: he who is not subjected to

literal: Legacy saying what will think indeed by anyone to desire he who is not subjected.
translation: What will he think of as his legacy, the man who is not desired by anyone?
modern: ஒருவராலும் விரும்பப்படாதவன், தனக்குப் பின் எஞ்சி நிற்பது என்று எதை நினைப்பானோ?
explanation: A person who hoards wealth without helping others is not loved or sought after by anyone. When such a person reflects on his life, he will find nothing of value to leave behind. The word eccam refers to what remains after one is gone, such as descendants or a good name, which the unloved miser entirely lacks.
